groups.why: نعيد تصميم تسع بطاقات. الباقة العادية فيها ثلاث مدد (٦ شهور، ٣ شهور، شهر)، والبلس فيها أربع (سنة، سنة لجهازين، ٦ شهور، ٣ شهور)، وبطاقتا تجديد (العادية والبلس). ملاحظة: لا توجد بطاقة «سنة + ٣ شهور» (حذفها العميل)، ولا توجد بطاقة «١٢ شهر» في العادية؛ «سنة» هي ١٢ شهر في البلس. أرقام البطاقات كما في الملف README.md (البطاقة ١ محذوفة والأرقام الأخرى ثابتة).
groups.how: الصورة في كل مهمة هي البطاقة الموجودة على المتجر اليوم، مقصوصة بدون الخلفية ومكبّرة. كل شيء في مجلد واحد 05-design/shared/subscription-cards/: القديمة في old/، والجديدة تُحفظ في new/ بالاسم المكتوب في «الملف الجديد». مقاس البطاقة الجديدة 760×1296 (مساحة البطاقة في الخلفيات المعتمدة B و E في subscription-backgrounds/)، PNG بزوايا مدورة شفافة. بعدها نضع البطاقة على الخلفية المعتمدة ونصدّر صورة المنتج لسلة. التفاصيل في README.md في نفس المجلد.

items.title: صورة AZ TV Box للمنتج المميز
items.spec: عريضة 16:9 (الأصل 2000×1116 من Gemini في 05-design/sections/05-aztv-box/aztv-box-dark-gemini.jpg، للموقع 1600×893 WebP)، الجهاز في الثلث الأيسر، النصف الأيمن فارغ
items.prompt:
I attached 3 reference images.
Image 1 is the exact product: the black AZ TV Box with the gold AZ TV logo on top, and its remote with the Netflix and YouTube buttons. Image 2 is the real store photo of the same device. Image 3 is the lighting and mood I want.

Keep the box and the remote exactly as in images 1 and 2: same shape, same proportions, same gold AZ TV logo, same buttons. Do not redesign or invent any part of the device. Remove everything else from the references: the price, the balloons, the gift box, the subscription card, the gem, the text and the stage.

Create a premium product photo for a dark website section:
- The box stands at a slight three-quarter angle with the remote leaning next to it, on a matte black surface with a soft reflection under it.
- Background: near-black #0D0D0D, fading into darkness at the edges. A little fog or haze low behind the product, like image 3.
- Light: one soft warm gold rim light (#EACF69) from behind and above that traces the edges of the box and the remote. A few very faint gold dust particles in the air. No other colours.
- Composition: wide 16:9 (2400 x 1350). Put the product on the LEFT third of the frame, about 55% of the frame height. The right 50% of the image must be completely empty dark space, because Arabic text will be placed there.
- Photorealistic, sharp focus on the logo, shallow depth of field in the background.
- No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos other than the AZ TV logo on the device, no watermark, no people, no hands, no props.

items.title: بنر «2 والثالث مجانًا» داكن
items.spec: كمبيوتر 1600×1064، جوال 800×1080. الأصل من Gemini: 05-design/sections/14-second-store/second-store-gemini.jpg (2000×1116).
items.prompt:
I attached 3 reference images.
Image 1 is the lighting and mood I want: black background, soft warm gold rim light, haze and a few gold dust particles, glossy dark floor.
Image 2 is a real green football shirt (Saudi national team). Image 3 is a real yellow football shirt (Brazil national team). These are the exact products of the store.

Keep both shirts EXACTLY as in images 2 and 3: same colours, same patterns, same collars and sleeves, and the same crests and brand marks in the same places. Do not redesign them, do not redraw or invent any crest, logo or text on them.

Create a premium banner for a football-shirt store offer "buy 2, get the third free":
- All the products sit together in the LEFT 55% of the frame: the green shirt behind on the left and the yellow shirt behind on the right, floating slightly, angled towards each other, front view. In front of them, in the centre of that group, an open black gift box with a thin gold ribbon, and a third shirt rising out of it: a plain white football shirt with no crest, no logo and no text (the free one).
- The RIGHT 45% of the frame must be completely empty: only near-black background with very soft haze. No objects, no confetti, no light spots there, because Arabic text and a logo will be placed on it.
- Background: near-black #0D0D0D fading to darkness at the edges, with soft haze like image 1. A warm gold rim light (#EACF69) from behind traces the shirts and the box. A few gold confetti flecks and fine gold dust in the air. A soft reflection on a dark glossy floor.
- Keep the far-left edge calm and dark, because the page crops the edges.
- Photorealistic, sharp fabric detail, shallow depth of field in the background.
- Do not add any text, letters, numbers, logos or watermark anywhere except what is already printed on the two attached shirts. No people.
Wide 16:9 (1600 x 900).

--- Phone version (send as a second request in the same chat) ---
Same image, same elements and mood, but composed for a phone: portrait 4:5 (800 x 1000). The open gift box with the white shirt rising out of it in the centre, the green shirt upper left and the yellow shirt upper right, all kept inside the TOP 60% of the frame. The BOTTOM 40% must be completely empty near-black space with only very soft haze, because Arabic text, a button and a logo will be placed there. Same rules: the two attached shirts exactly as they are, no other text or logos.
